caption:
Plugging Claude into WhatsApp to answer your DMs sounds smart until you read the fine print.
It only replies when you open Claude and ask, it runs through WhatsApp Web instead of the official API, and its own README warns about private data leaking.
Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: he replies on his own in your voice, through Manychat on the official WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, and hands you the chat when he doesn't know.
Comment SETTY and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
